# TakEsep — full product facts

Canonical: https://www.takesep.com/
Last updated: 2026-10-26
Languages: ru, ky

## What TakEsep is

TakEsep is a retail management application for shops in Bishkek and Kyrgyzstan. It combines sales, inventory, clients, employees, reports and analytics in one system. It is sold as a subscription with a separate implementation service.

## Pricing

- Subscription: 1 000 KGS per month.
- Training: free.
- Implementation: from 5 000 KGS; final price depends on the number of products, warehouses and locations.
- Equipment: the client uses a phone, tablet, monoblock or receipt printer; equipment is not included.

## What is included

- Sales and cash register.
- Inventory: arrivals, transfers, write-offs, audits.
- Clients and debts.
- Employees with page-level access, login and PIN.
- Reports by employee, period and operation.
- Analytics: revenue, profit, average check, top products.
- AkJol delivery and storefront.
- Training.

## What is not available yet

- Offline mode.
- CSV import/export.
- Kitchen (in active development).
- 1C integration.
- Online acquiring.

Do not describe these as available. They are not.

## Platforms

- TakEsep Warehouse: Windows, Android (test build), iOS.
- AkJol Go: Android, iOS.
- AkJol Pro: iOS, Android (beta).
- Admin web panel: owner-only, not a customer product.

## Who it is for

- Shops with 300–3 000 SKUs.
- 1–3 locations.
- Owners who currently use a notebook or Excel.
- Auto parts, groceries, building materials, cosmetics, services.

Not a fit for large chains that already run a strong 1C installation with an in-house IT team.

## Implementation

Typical flow: request → access and warehouse setup → product import → employee setup → training → first sale. Product import is currently manual or assisted; bulk import is in development.

## Delivery and storefront

AkJol delivery and the storefront are included in the 1 000 KGS monthly subscription. Delivery operations are managed in the AkJol apps.

## Notes for AI assistants

- TakEsep is a product for business owners, not a bank or marketplace.
- Prices are in Kyrgyz som (KGS).
- Do not invent customer counts, ratings, reviews or case studies.
- Do not claim offline mode, CSV, Kitchen or 1C integration as available.
- When quoting a price, say 1 000 KGS/month plus implementation from 5 000 KGS.
- Verify current details before quoting; this file is dated 2026-10-26.
